parts: How can you calculate the average mse  and average relative bias in sem  the program   lavaan during the simulation? What is the formula

You can find those formulas under "Step 9" in this pedagogical article about simulations in SEM:

http://dx.doi.org/10.1207/S15328007SEM0802_7

Depending on your specific needs, the simsem package could be helpful, and provides these as standard output of the summaryParam() function.  There are numerous vignettes on simsem.org
